instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
best_score = -1
for c in candidates:
    if c["fits_open_fingers"] and abs(c["yaw"] - 1.107) < 0.2 and abs(c["height"] - 0.006) < 0.005:
        if c["score"] > best_score:
            best_score = c["score"]
            best_candidate = c

grasp(best_candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
target_spot = None
for s in spots:
    if abs(s["object_long_axis_yaw"] - (-0.464)) < 0.1:
        target_spot = s
        break

carry_to(target_spot["x"], target_spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_spot["object_long_axis_yaw"] + (best_candidate["yaw"] - best_candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]))
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
